title: Computer history
description: Capture which apps, windows and pages you focus on so the assistant can answer questions about your recent work. Everything stays on this machine.
enableHint: While on, the recorder logs one segment per app or tab you focus, with titles and page addresses redacted of secrets.
permissionNeeded: Capture is on but macOS has not granted the access it needs, so nothing is being recorded.
permissionHowTo: Allow NomiFun under 辅助功能 (Accessibility) and, for page addresses, 完全磁盘访问 (Full Disk Access) in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then refresh.
retentionHint: Segments older than {{days}} days are deleted automatically.
purgeConfirmBody: This permanently deletes {{count}} recorded segments on this machine. This cannot be undone.
timelineEmpty: No activity captured in this window yet.
